name: s5-s6-preregistration-b
title: Final experimental preregistration of the S5-S6 retrieval selection, pinned by the hash of a private document
document_status: private; kept outside the public repository
scope: the rules of the single labelled read of six retrieval systems on DEV (E5, D-4B, E, E5 + BM25 by RRF, E5 + reranker at N=20 and N=50): frozen candidate sources, latency classes, displacement and dominance rules, the nine labels, the deterministic coverage sensitivity envelope, the budget of six looks and the stop rules; no TEST v2
amends_document_sha256: none; builds on stage A and amendment A.1, which it does not modify
amendments: append-only: a later version is a new document with a new hash, published before it is used
note: The commit that adds this file is the public timestamp: the rules, the candidate runs and the code of the rules were fixed before any label of the read was opened.
